preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
For each test case, the number of nodes N and the number of trees K must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each node value A_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u[i] <= N and 1 <= v[i] <= N and u[i] != v[i] for i in range(N-1))
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible value of the bitwise AND of the XOR values of the K trees.
